_comment: Official NEET (UG) pattern, transcribed from the NTA Information Bulletin NEET (UG)-2026, Chapter 4 'Examination Scheme'. The bulletin lists Biology as one subject of 90 questions; the printed paper splits it into Botany (45) and Zoology (45), which PrepMitra uses as two sections so each section draws on one subject. Marks live here, not on questions.

exams.name: NEET (UG)
exams.conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA), syllabus by the National Medical Commission (NMC)
exams.pattern_history: 2021-2024: 200 questions (Section A 35 + Section B 15 of which 10 attempted, per subject), 200 minutes. From 2025: 180 compulsory questions, 180 minutes. 2026 kept the 2025 pattern.
